profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Intelligent Video Analytics Applications at NVIDIA
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, Intelligent Video Analytics Applications
profile.summary: A passionate Senior Software Engineer with a diverse technical background who enjoys overcoming challenges while continuously learning to improve

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Intelligent Video Analytics Applications
Software Engineer Specialist
positions.description:
- Implement video analytic and image processing features with OpenCV, Dlib, FFMpeg, and Python with focus on face detection, face recognition, object detection, and tracking
- Research and train Convolution Deep Neural Network models with Keras and Caffe
- Develop Hitachi Visualization Suite web application with ASP.NET, C#, ReactJS, Redux, AWS S3 SDK, RabbitMQ API, Mongo API and create unit tests with xUnit, Ensure.That
- Work as a feature team lead to communicate with product owner and coordinate team effort
- Developed Digital Evidence Management web application and RESTful API with Java, JAX-RS, Jersey, Vert.x, MongoDB, AngularJS

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop web apps with ASP.NET, JSP, Servlet, XHTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, and
JQuery for users to retrieve and analyze memory testing data
- Setup IIS and Apache Tomcat to host web apps and enforce authentication
- Design, implement, and maintain MSSQL and MySQL DB for the memory testing data
- Implement DB loader with C# to load data into MSSQL and MySQL DB
- Write SQL queries and stored procedures to retrieve data from MySQL and MSSQL DB
to generate customized reports in XML, JSON, Excel and CSV formats with C# and Java
- Implement both GUI and console based applications with C#, C++, MFC, and JAVA
- Write Bash and Perl scripts to manipulate and handle raw input files in UNIX
- Setup Cronjob to utilize Bash and Perl scripts to automate raw input file processing

positions.title: Application Analyst
positions.description:
- Configure Apache settings for the Ad Servers and dynamic hosting on CentOS.
- Design and create UI mockup with DHTML (JavaScript, CSS, and XHTML) and Flash
- Gather requirements from users and write requirement document.
- Upgrade e-commerce and Ad server on UNIX environment.
- Verify and report bugs by analyzing the system and its error log

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Created reports by using Crystal Report, Eclipse, and MySQL
- Integrated reports generated by Crystal Report to the website for dynamic inquires
- Created requirement specification and report documents

projects.title: Hitachi Visualization Suite
projects.description:
• Develop RESTful API with ASP.NET, C#, AWS S3 SDK, RabbitMQ, and MongoDB
• Implement web UI with ReactJS, Redux, Redux-Saga, CSS, JavaScript, and XHTML
• Architect and implement scalable video analytics solution with OpenCV, Dlib, FFMpeg, and
Python with focus on face detection, face recognition, and tracking
• Train CNN models for object detection with Keras and Caffe
• Create unit tests and integration tests with xUnit.net and incorporate Jenkins for CI/CD
• Use GitLab for source code management and Jira for task/bug management
• Write high level design and detailed design documents and work as a feature team lead
• Participate in Agile ceremonies including glooming, sprint planning, and retrospective meeting

projects.title: Digital Evidence Management System
projects.description:
- Developed non-blocking high availability RESTful API with JAX-RS, Jersey, and Vert.x
- Incorporated .NET Workflow Engine with RabbitMQ to allow RPC request with ACK
- Utilized AWS.S3 SDK to support file object management on HCP through HS3 API
- Enhanced and debugged front-end UI with AngularJS, XHTML, CSS
- Implemented functions to search and retrieve data from both ElasticSearch and MongoDB
